description: Adds an effort field to tasks, redesigns the mobile task row to eliminate horizontal scrolling, and makes the task detail view editable.

open_question_resolutions.effort_required_or_optional: optional — effort is nullable; existing tasks remain valid without it
open_question_resolutions.effort_unit: double (hours) — the smallest-change path per the spec recommendation; integer-minutes can be adopted in a later sprint for calendar integration
open_question_resolutions.effort_display: display as '2.5 h' — one decimal place, suffix 'h'; blank/null renders as '—'
open_question_resolutions.effort_truncation_mobile: task name truncates with text-overflow: ellipsis; effort and priority chips are fixed-width and never truncate
open_question_resolutions.effort_in_create_form: yes — effort is included in the create form in this sprint; it is optional so users who skip it are not blocked
open_question_resolutions.detail_edit_scope: all currently visible task fields: title, description, status, priority, due_date, effort

migration.description: Adds nullable double-precision effort_hours column to tasktracker.tasks
migration.sql_summary: ALTER TABLE tasktracker.tasks ADD COLUMN effort_hours double precision CHECK (effort_hours IS NULL OR effort_hours >= 0);

changes.detail: New ColumnSchema entry: key='effort_hours', label='Effort (h)', type='number', sortable=True, filterable=False
Optional field effort_hours: float | None = None; validated >= 0 if provided
Optional field effort_hours: float | None = None; validated >= 0 if provided

changes.what: Include effort_hours in INSERT and SELECT queries
changes.detail: All SELECT * and INSERT INTO statements already cover effort_hours via the existing wildcard/column-list patterns; update explicit column lists in create_task and list_tasks to include effort_hours

changes.what: Validate effort_hours >= 0 in create_task and update_task
changes.detail: Return api_error('VALIDATION_ERROR', 'effort_hours must be >= 0') if provided value is negative

backend_layer.backward_compatibility: Existing rows have effort_hours = NULL. row_to_dict already handles None gracefully. No breaking change.

frontend_layer.overview: ShellEntry.tsx is the sole frontend file. It is restructured to support: (a) a mobile card-list view for tasks with ThreeDotsMenu, (b) an editable detail view replacing the read-only DetailView platform primitive.

components_introduced.name: TaskRow
components_introduced.description: Mobile-optimised card row showing task name (truncated), effort chip, priority chip, and a three-dots menu. Tapping the card body opens detail. Three-dots menu has 'Mark Complete' and 'Delete' actions.
components_introduced.layout: Single flex row: [name (flex:1, overflow:ellipsis)] [effort chip] [priority chip] [ThreeDotsMenu (flexShrink:0)]

components_introduced.name: ThreeDotsMenu
components_introduced.description: Vertical three-dots (⋮) button that opens a dropdown menu. Menu items: 'Mark complete' (PATCH status=done) and 'Delete' (DELETE). Click-outside closes the menu.

components_introduced.name: TaskDetailEdit
components_introduced.description: Replaces the read-only platform DetailView for task detail. Renders all task fields (title, description, status, priority, due_date, effort_hours) as editable inputs. Save submits PATCH /tasks/{id}. Cancel discards changes and returns to list.
components_introduced.note: This is an app-local component — platform DetailView does not support editing and is not extended here

components_removed.name: TableView (platform)
components_removed.reason: Platform TableView renders a <table> which causes horizontal overflow on mobile. Replaced with the TaskRow card-list pattern for the tasks page.

components_removed.name: DetailView (platform)
components_removed.reason: Platform DetailView is read-only. Replaced with app-local TaskDetailEdit which is editable.

task_create_form_change.description: Add effort_hours to TASK_FIELDS in the existing CreateForm usage

data_flow.list: GET /tasks?page=N — response is Dataset; rows extracted and rendered as TaskRow cards
data_flow.mark_complete: PATCH /tasks/{id} body {status: 'done'} — on success update local state (no full re-fetch required)
data_flow.delete: DELETE /tasks/{id} — on success filter row from local state
data_flow.open_detail: State: selected task row stored in component state; TaskDetailEdit rendered with current values pre-filled
data_flow.save_detail: PATCH /tasks/{id} body {all edited fields} — on success update local state and return to list
data_flow.create: POST /tasks — on success setCreating(false) and refetch list

mobile_layout_invariants: No horizontal overflow on the task list at any viewport width
Task name truncates at available space; effort and priority chips remain visible
ThreeDotsMenu is always reachable without scrolling
Row tap (outside three-dots zone) opens detail

platform_contracts.dataset_contract: Retained — all endpoints continue to return Dataset. effort_hours added to TASK_SCHEMA.
platform_contracts.row_actions: list endpoint declares row_actions=['edit','delete']; edit is handled via row click, delete via three-dots menu
platform_contracts.create_form: Platform CreateForm primitive is retained for task creation; effort_hours added as a number field

non_scope: New task actions beyond mark-complete and delete
Platform TableView or DetailView changes — app-local components are used instead

dependencies.name: platform-ui
dependencies.usage: apiFetch, isApiError, ErrorCard, Skeleton, CreateForm — retained; TableView and DetailView no longer used on tasks page
